# Snake Game 🐍 Made this little game for Web Dev College labs to learn VanillaJS # Demo 🔍 # Quick Start 🚀 ```git clone https://github.com/irevenko/snake-game.git```
```cd snake-game```
```open public/index.html in your browser, move with Arrows``` # What I Learned 🧠 * HTML Canvas * Some JS OOP * Basic Game Dev (a little bit of Geometry and Algebra) * window Object # License 📑 (c) 2020 Ilya Revenko. [MIT License](https://tldrlegal.com/license/mit-license)
